lines.text: You probably didn't know this about money.
lines.tts: You probably didn't know this about money.

lines.text: Most money today is not actually cash.
lines.tts: Most money today is not actually cash.

lines.text: It's not sitting somewhere as paper bills or coins.
lines.tts: It's not sitting somewhere as paper bills or coins.

lines.text: If your balance says 2,000$, that doesn't mean the bank has a box with 2,000$ in cash with your name on it.
lines.tts: If your balance says two thousand dollars, that doesn't mean the bank has a box with two thousand dollars in cash with your name on it.

lines.text: It simply means their system records that you have 2,000$ available.
lines.tts: It simply means their system records that you have two thousand dollars available.

lines.text: When someone sends you money, cash usually doesn't physically move anywhere.
lines.tts: When someone sends you money, cash usually doesn't physically move anywhere.

lines.text: The same thing happens when you use your card, pay online, or receive your salary.
lines.tts: The same thing happens when you use your card, pay online, or receive your salary.

lines.text: So most of the money we use every day is really just numbers stored in banking systems.
lines.tts: So most of the money we use every day is really just numbers stored in banking systems.

lines.text: Physical cash is only a small part of it.
lines.tts: Physical cash is only a small part of it.

lines.text: Money today is mostly digital information.
